opening.fr: Que sait-on de la vie familiale de Giuseppe Sarto à Riese ?
opening.en: The Museo San Pio X family history describes Giuseppe Sarto's household, parents and siblings in Riese. It establishes family circumstances but does not preserve a first-person account of his private childhood thoughts.

question.en: Can we reconstruct his private feelings toward every family member?
question.fr: Peut-on reconstituer ses sentiments envers chaque membre de sa famille ?

response.en: Not from that witness. The available biographical account reports family relationships and circumstances, without authenticating intimate statements made in the boy's own voice.
response.fr: Pas à partir de ce témoignage. La notice biographique rapporte des liens et des circonstances familiales, sans authentifier des confidences intimes prononcées par le jeune garçon.

opening.fr: Comment sa famille a-t-elle contribué à sa première éducation religieuse ?
opening.en: The museum's historical account documents a religious family and parish environment during Sarto's childhood. It supports the existence of this setting, but not a precise private explanation of each parent's influence on his vocation.

question.en: Did Sarto himself credit one parent in these surviving lines?
question.fr: Sarto attribue-t-il lui-même le mérite à l'un de ses parents dans ces lignes ?

response.en: No such first-person attribution has been established in the cited passage. The account should remain biographical rather than be turned into a recollection placed in his mouth.
response.fr: Aucune attribution personnelle de cette sorte n'est établie dans le passage cité. Il faut conserver la forme biographique sans transformer le récit en souvenir mis dans sa bouche.

opening.fr: Que sait-on des premiers signes de sa vocation sacerdotale ?
opening.en: The museum's childhood account reports early prayer and the emergence of a priestly vocation, including episodes associated with Cendrole. These are later historical reports, not a diary recording his hidden motives.

question.en: Can an exact inner moment of vocation be identified?
question.fr: Peut-on identifier l'instant intérieur exact de sa vocation ?

response.en: Not from this evidence. The chronology of his religious life can be described, but an undocumented private moment should not be invented.
response.fr: Non à partir de cette preuve. On peut décrire la chronologie de sa vie religieuse, mais non inventer un instant intérieur qui n'est pas documenté.

opening.fr: Que fit Giuseppe Sarto au séminaire de Padoue ?
opening.en: The museum's biography identifies Sarto's years at the seminary of Padua, his studies, musical activity and responsibilities among fellow students. It does not quote his own retrospective evaluation of every lesson.

question.en: Did his seminary years include musical work?
question.fr: Ses années de séminaire comportaient-elles une activité musicale ?

response.en: Yes. Musical activity is among the documented elements of his formation; later liturgical policy should not be presented as a private prediction he made at the seminary.
response.fr: Oui. L'activité musicale figure parmi les éléments documentés de sa formation ; on ne doit pas présenter sa future politique liturgique comme une prédiction privée faite au séminaire.

opening.fr: Quel fut son premier ministère à Tombolo ?
opening.en: The later biography records Giuseppe Sarto's early priestly service at Tombolo between 1858 and 1867. It gives the setting and chronology of his pastoral work without an authenticated first-person account of what each encounter taught him.

question.en: May we put an invented pastoral lesson into his voice?
question.fr: Peut-on lui attribuer une leçon pastorale inventée ?

response.en: No. A biographer's record of ministry does not supply the precise words or interior reflections of the priest who performed it.
response.fr: Non. Le récit d'un biographe sur le ministère ne fournit ni les paroles exactes ni les réflexions intérieures du prêtre qui l'exerça.

opening.fr: Que faisait-il comme curé de Salzano ?
opening.en: Biographical sources place Giuseppe Sarto in parish ministry at Salzano from 1867 to 1875 and report demanding pastoral activity. His catechetical manuscript gives further evidence of the teaching material associated with this period.

question.en: Can the Salzano Catechism reveal his interests more securely than an imagined memory?
question.fr: Le catéchisme de Salzano révèle-t-il ses préoccupations mieux qu'un souvenir imaginé ?

response.en: It provides actual educational material associated with Sarto, whereas the biographical chronology alone cannot tell us his private thoughts on a particular day.
response.fr: Il fournit un véritable matériel d'enseignement associé à Sarto, tandis que la seule chronologie biographique ne révèle pas ses pensées privées un jour déterminé.

opening.fr: Quelles charges occupa-t-il à la curie de Trévise ?
opening.en: The biographical record identifies Sarto's service in the diocesan curia, including chancellery and seminary responsibilities, and his role as a canon after the Salzano years. It establishes offices, not a transcript of his reflections on them.

question.en: Can we know from this alone how those offices changed his temperament?
question.fr: Cette seule source montre-t-elle comment ces charges transformèrent son caractère ?

response.en: No. Institutional appointments can be documented, but attributing a precise psychological transformation requires independent personal testimony.
response.fr: Non. Les nominations institutionnelles peuvent être établies, mais une transformation psychologique précise exige un témoignage personnel indépendant.

opening.fr: Quels défis rencontra-t-il comme évêque de Mantoue ?
opening.en: Later biographies describe pastoral renewal and difficult diocesan circumstances during Sarto's episcopate at Mantua. They also mention challenges in relations with public authorities and Christian social work.

question.en: Does this prove the words of a private conversation he held with officials?
question.fr: Cela prouve-t-il les paroles d'une conversation privée avec les autorités ?

response.en: No. A summary of administrative and pastoral difficulties should not be expanded into an unattested dialogue with named officials.
response.fr: Non. Le résumé de difficultés administratives et pastorales ne doit pas être développé en un dialogue non attesté avec des responsables nommés.

opening.fr: Que réalisa-t-il comme patriarche de Venise ?
opening.en: The biographical record documents Sarto's appointment as Patriarch of Venice and describes pastoral and social initiatives during his tenure. It does not itself authenticate a detailed first-person manifesto of his private intentions.

question.en: Can we distinguish documented action from attributed intention?
question.fr: Peut-on distinguer l'action documentée de l'intention attribuée ?

response.en: Yes. An appointment or initiative may be a historical fact, while claiming that Sarto privately intended a particular future policy requires a separate source.
response.fr: Oui. Une nomination ou une initiative peut être un fait historique, tandis qu'attribuer à Sarto une intention privée précise concernant une politique future demande une autre source.
